verdict.rationale: A local programmatic endpoint for retrieving codes and secrets is a fair question for an authenticator or vault app, so the axis applies. The evidence documents no API, CLI or local endpoint. The Screen Capture setting enables exactly the screen-scraping the story wants to avoid, and Export Passwords is a one-off manual export rather than a queryable endpoint, so both are only adjacent. Probes for OpenAPI and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can expose the vault through a local programmatic endpoint an agent can query for codes and secrets without screen-scraping the app
